description: Turkish Air Force Skyservant at Köşk Mahallesi on Ahmet El Biruni Caddesi. Serial 4010 is also its construction number. Last updated 4 June 2020.

Two-seat Starfighter about 150 m from the Do 28 at Köşk Mahallesi, wearing the code 8-703. Construction number 583D-5703. The International F-104 Society places this airframe at Erciyes Üniversitesi and records refurbishment around 2013. Confirmed present on Esri World Imagery examined September 2026.
